decisions.reason: As a consumer superfood drink far from a German chemical firm's core activities, and with only early website presence but no sign of stronger follow-through, its option value appears low relative to the cost of managerial attention.

Modular waste-to-energy extensions are adjacent to the firm's industrial and environmental technology base, and because such B2B offerings can be kept available at relatively low cost while demand uncertainty resolves, the option is still worth keeping open.

The waste-oil-to-energy plant received the strongest early commitment with its own page and a formal launch statement, so for a related industrial product with long sales cycles it is rational to continue holding the option open.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel technology fits the firm's broader waste-to-value portfolio, and despite uncertainty its dedicated presentation suggests enough potential that abandoning it now would forgo upside before the market has fully revealed its value.
